channel.description: Latest articles from The Hollywood Reporter Inc. (thr.com)

item.title: Disney’s ‘Robin Hood’ Live-Action Remake Not Moving Forward, Says Director
item.description: "It's dead, sadly," Carlos López Estrada revealed about the project that was first announced in 2020.

item.title: Ben Stiller Asks White House to Remove ‘Tropic Thunder’ From Iran War Propaganda Video
item.description: The actor-director objected to his hit comedy being included in a new video: "War is not a movie."

item.title: The Alysa Liu Effect: PinkPantheress and Zara Larsson’s “Stateside” Gets Post-Olympics Bump
item.description: After the Olympic gold medalist’s 2026 Exhibition Gala performance went viral, the song has been climbing the charts.

item.title: Pink Palace Expansion: Beverly Hills Hotel to Unveil First Additions in Decades With Five New Spaces (Exclusive)
item.description: The blueprints, in the works for six years, will introduce a supper club and luxury dining destination, a cocktail bar and outdoor terrace, an indoor-outdoor lounge, screening room and a private dining room.

item.title: Kanye “Ye” West Reportedly Struggles to Stay Awake While Testifying at Los Angeles Mansion Trial
item.description: The rapper-designer yawned and nodded off while answering "I don't recall" when questioned about the home designed by Japanese architect Tadao Ando, according to reports.

item.title: Alan Trustman, Screenwriter on ‘The Thomas Crown Affair’ and ‘Bullitt,’ Dies at 95
item.description: After working on the Steve McQueen classics, the former attorney penned ‘They Call Me Mister Tibbs!’

item.title: Writers Guild Negotiations Priorities Approved by Members: Health Plan Funding, AI and Compensation
item.description: More than 97 percent of participating union members voted to approve the slate of contract demands.

item.title: Jeremy Larner, Oscar-Winning Screenwriter on Robert Redford’s ‘The Candidate,’ Dies at 88
item.description: A speechwriter for presidential candidate Eugene McCarthy, he also adapted his novel for the Jack Nicholson-directed ‘Drive, He Said.’

item.title: Bill Maher Gets “Honest” With Donald Trump About President’s Successes and Failures: “I Have Every Right to Say So in a Democracy”
item.description: The 'Real Time' host, as promised, addressed the commander-in-chief's recent criticism including the dinner the president now says was a waste of time.
